title: fix(plugin-view): a read-only view's menus no longer open empty or on a leading separator
body:
Fixes #10209
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Each of the three menus resolves its entries once, to the handler each entry will run (or `undefined` when the entry will not render). The entries, the separators and the trigger all read those same values. So a trigger renders only when at least one entry renders, and a separator is drawn only between two groups that both rendered. One predicate per menu, no parallel condition.

- `ManageViewsDialog` row `…` menu: the trigger used to render on `onDelete || onDuplicate || onConfigView || onSetDefault` (is a callback wired?), while every entry under it was also gated on `!isReadonly`. With the console's props (no `onDuplicate`, objectui#1520) a read-only row opened an empty 180px popover strip. Now a read-only row shows no `…` trigger; with `onDuplicate` wired it opens on Duplicate alone.
- `ViewTabBar` tab dropdown (`▾`): separators before Delete and before "Manage all views…" now render only when something rendered above them. A read-only tab opens on "Manage all views…" with no leading separator. A read-only tab with no `onManageViews` shows no trigger (before: an empty dropdown).
- `ViewTabBar` tab context menu (right-click): same defect in the same file, fixed the same way. A read-only tab's context menu no longer opens on a leading separator. A tab with no surviving entry is no longer wrapped in a context menu at all; before, it opened an empty one. This also covers every tab for a non-admin console user, who gets no callbacks.

Reverse control: an editable view keeps every entry it had. The dialog row with all six callbacks still shows six entries with one separator above Delete.

## One deliberate adjustment, and why

`ManageViewsDialog` no longer offers Rename (the menu entry or a double-click on the label) when the host wires no `onRename`. Committing a rename calls `onRename?.(…)`, so without it the entry did nothing. Before this change that no-op entry was hidden behind the callback-shaped trigger guard. With the trigger now asking whether any entry renders, an editable row on a host that wires no callbacks would otherwise gain a `…` that only offers a Rename that does nothing. The console wires `onRename`, so console behaviour is unchanged.

The existing forward control `ViewTabBar.setDefaultVisibility.test.tsx` opened a read-only tab's dropdown on a host that wired no `onManageViews`. Under this change that tab has no trigger, because nothing in its menu survives `readonly`. The test now wires `onManageViews` so the menu opens, and it still asserts that set-default, rename and delete are absent. Its header also cited two `ViewTabBar.tsx` line numbers across files; while touching the file I replaced them with the entries' test ids (AGENTS.md #11, opportunistic repair).

## Evidence (head `ebc4146`)

- New pins: `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/readonlyViewMenus-10209.test.tsx` has 10 tests over the dialog row menu, the tab dropdown and the tab context menu. They assert the menu's child roles in order (`menuitem` / `separator`) and whether each trigger is present.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-view/` (repo root): `Test Files 45 passed (45)`, `Tests 414 passed (414)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-view type-check` (after building the dependency closure `@object-ui/plugin-view^...`, 16 projects): exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes both touched test files.
- Reverse verification, run after the fix was committed: both source files checked out at base `8b1f066`, then the new file run again: `Tests 6 failed | 4 passed (10)`. The 6 red are the empty or leading-separator cases (dialog read-only trigger, dialog Delete-alone, tab dropdown read-only with and without manage, context menu read-only with and without manage). The 4 green are the three editable reverse controls and read-only-with-Duplicate, which were already correct. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- …`; `git diff HEAD` is empty and both blob hashes match HEAD.
- Gates run locally, all exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:unreferenced-sources`.
- Lint, narrowed to the 4 touched source and test files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` reports 4 files, 0 errors and 5 warnings. All 5 warnings are on untouched pre-existing lines (`no-explicit-any` in the label helpers, `set-state-in-effect` in the existing effects). `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file. The full `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, per triage: whether a code-defined view should be read-only at all, and `ViewTabBar`'s `allReadonly` rule hiding the per-tab lock badge. objectui#10210 (the root cause that most often puts a view into the read-only state) remains open and is untouched here.
- The reference branch `claude/quirky-wozniak-h2bt8o` (`68455999`) was read but not cherry-picked. Everything was re-derived on `main`. Its lock-tooltip addition was left out as out of scope.
- `Spec Main Shape Gate` is red on every PR from upstream drift (objectui#10287, being handled by another seat). It is unrelated to this diff.
